_framework_extension.what_it_does: Allows the `{component}` segment of the v1.3 pattern to be nested as `{family}/{variant}` when a cluster ships multiple sibling-variant components that share a conceptual family (here: 3 Tabs variants). Exports as `--component-{family}-{variant}-{property}-...` at the CSS-var layer; v1.3 parsers treat `{family}-{variant}` as a registered compound slug.
_framework_extension.why_this_cluster: Cluster #15 is the first to ship multiple sibling code components grouped as one family. Tabs has 3 separate code components (folder-tabs, inline-tabs, navigation-tabs) with separate *-vars.scss files that do NOT share tokens (folder uses opacity-dimming; inline+nav use per-state colors). Flat slugs would scatter the 3 across A-Z sorting in the Figma Variables panel; nested groups them under `tabs/` for predictability + findability + future extensibility. Storybook + Figma layer naming + code dir all already use nested `Tabs/{variant}/` organization at their respective layers — nested spec namespace aligns the token-name layer with the rest.
constraints: Family slug must be conceptually accurate. Tabs family = tabs only. Segmented Control ships as its own top-level slug `component/segmented-control/*` (distinct UX pattern per Component Gallery taxonomy).

Phase 6 code-side migration: current `--tds-{variant}-tabs-*` legacy CSS vars get renamed to `--component-tabs-{variant}-...` (family-first order matches spec). One-off code rename, not a permanent constraint.
Property-first naming inside the namespace still applies: `component/tabs/{variant}/{property}/{scope}/{descriptor}-{state}` (Side Menu shape). No exceptions.
_framework_extension.precedent_for: Any future cluster shipping multiple sibling-variant code components as one design family (potential candidates: Date Picker family if range+single split, future Selector family, etc.).
_framework_extension.superseded_note: REVERSED 2026-07-04. The variant-first nesting was dropped for property-first, per an evidence pass over SHIPPED specs (property-first is universal; the nesting broke the shipped leaf/depth ceilings). Anchored on chip (flat descriptor form), Header/Side Menu (interior scope), Popover (mode-variant-in-leaf) — all shipped. Dropdown looked like a twin but is WIP in another conversation, so it is NOT the anchor.

_notes: STRUCTURE (rev 8, 2026-07-04): property-first `component/tabs/{property}/{leaf}`. ITEM-LEVEL tokens nest under an `item/` scope in ALL three colour categories (background, border, text); BAR/WRAPPER-level tokens stay FLAT directly under the property, because they don't belong to a tab item. `item/` communicates belonging + purpose (not just disambiguation) and reads consistently in the Variables panel. — background: `background/item/{mode-variant}/{state}` (item/ + mode-variant/ scopes; e.g. `primary/current-default`) + bars `background/{primary,secondary,folder-primary,folder-secondary}` (flat). — border: item-level `border/item/{default,hover,indicator-default,divider-default}` + bar/wrapper `border/{default,folder-default}` (flat). — text: `text/item/{default,current-default,folder-default}` (all text is item-level; the bar renders no text). — opacity: `opacity/disabled` (single shared token, flat). `current` is a selection STATUS (aria-current), NOT an interaction state, so it carries its own state in the leaf (`current-default`, room for a future `current-hover`). `standard` (underline tab, inline+nav) = unmarked default; `folder` = marked exception WHERE a standard counterpart exists (`text/item/folder-default` is marked; `border/item/divider-default` is unmarked — folder-only, no standard counterpart). Precedent: property-first universal (chip/header/side-menu/button/accordion/popover); `item/` interior scope + `border/item/indicator-default` + `text/item/current-default` all shipped in Header/Side-Menu; `current-default` leaf from Header/Side-Menu/Breadcrumbs. NEW PATTERN (2026-07-04, cluster #15): nesting the mode-variant as a FURTHER scope under `item/` (background only) pairs a mode-variant axis with a selection status — no shipped token did this; it is the system's first depth-6, taken deliberately to keep the `current-default` leaf clean rather than stack option+status+state into a 3-part leaf (Max: no 3-part hyphen leaves unless the name itself forces it, e.g. `sub-link-{state}`). Tabs sets the precedent; Segmented Control inherits it. Popover's flat `background/link/primary-default` is the prior mode-variant×state shape but carries no selection status, so it is not the anchor here. NOTE: Dropdown is a parallel WIP in another conversation — NOT a shipped anchor; do not cite it as precedent.

FOLDER vs STANDARD text models differ by design (code-verified): standard (inline+nav) is PER-COLOUR (text/item/default soft → text/item/current-default strong); folder is ONE strong colour (text/item/folder-default) differentiated by elevated background + top stripe, with opacity for disabled only. Do not homogenise.
